description: This file defines the entity class 'DepositAccountTermAndPreClosure' which models the terms and pre-closure details of a deposit account in a banking application. It includes fields for deposit amounts, dates, periods, closure options, and references to related account and detail objects. The class provides methods for creating new instances, updating fields, copying objects, and calculating periods, encapsulating core business logic related to deposit account terms and pre-closure handling.

classes.name: DepositAccountTermAndPreClosure
classes.description: Entity class representing deposit account term and pre-closure details within the savings account domain. Manages deposit amounts, periods, maturity, closure options, and related details, providing methods for creation, updating, copying, and calculations related to deposit terms.

methods.name: createNew
methods.description: Static factory method to instantiate a new DepositAccountTermAndPreClosure object with specified details, including pre-closure, deposit term, account, amounts, dates, and closure options.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates the deposit terms and closure details based on provided JsonCommand input, tracking changes and validating data.
